title: Four Core Colours
label: ch:hi-core-colours
canDo: I can name black, white, red and blue in Hindi and say which of them came from Sanskrit and which from Persian.

payoff.summary: Say लाल and नीला beside काला and सफ़ेद, keeping nīla and 'indigo' honestly linked by trade rather than by sound.
payoff.note: HI-C11-laal-niila now recalls काला's tie to kāla, 'time', and सफ़ेद's Persian origin and nuqtā as well as its own pair: 4 of the chapter's 6 atoms. The two one-character recognition segments (HI-S06-vowel-sign-aa, HI-S115-letter-ya, sequence 565-566) come after the payoff in reading order, so they stay out of it; they belong to the script strand's own ramp.
